title: Tidepool stopped uploading on latest 3.4.0/1 dev versions
body: **AndroidAPS 3.4.1.0-dev**: Latest dev builds **Flavor**: fullrelease **Problem**: Since latest 3.4.0/1 dev versions, Tidepool stopt uploading. **Observation:** I can reestablish uploading by logging off and then login again, followed by "upload now" or "Full Sync" In the logfiles I find: 15:54:35.406 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-20] D/TIDEPOOL: [TidepoolPlugin.doUpload():152]: doUpload from=EventTidepoolDoUpload isAllowed=true status=SESSION_ESTABLISHED 15:54:35.408 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-20] E/CORE: [TidepoolUploader.doUpload():226]: Session is null, cannot proceed _ Looks like session is not persisted/recreated on AAPS (re)starts? **logcat**: **Logfiles:** [AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25911966/AndroidAPS.log) [AndroidAPS_LOG_1773244646221.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25911973/AndroidAPS_LOG_1773244646221.log.zip)

comments.body: 3.4.1.0, same issue. Logging out and then back in resolved the issue for a few days but then it stopped again. I upgraded from 3.3.2.1. prior to upgrade no issues.
